asks: Do you want the first move?
Shall I start again where you can see it?
description: A block of interlocking wooden and brass panels, sliding against one another in a slow sequence that is clearly going somewhere. It has the dimensions of the safe it replaced and considerably more moving parts.
emotes: {it} slides two panels and locks them with a click.
{it} undoes a long sequence back to the beginning.
{it} opens by a finger width and closes again.
looks: The panels move in a fixed order and the order is long enough that you lose the start of it.
The grain runs continuously across panels that are not touching, and were never one piece.
One face is nearly solved and has been nearly solved throughout.
name: a puzzle box the size of a safe
says: Two hundred and eleven moves. You are welcome to start.
It opens. That is not in question.
You have already undone four of them by looking.
